time.sleep(0.3)
# if it didn’t land on the right-tab icon, click again:
pyautogui.click(260, 250)
time.sleep(0.5)

# 2) Place the right-aligned tab stop at the right margin (~6.5" on the ruler)
pyautogui.click(900, 250)
time.sleep(0.5)
